title: The Team Activation Process: Tune In, Lock In, Then Go

intelligence.essence: Shawn's order, 02:05Z on 2026-11-10 — how the team of agents is set up in the most intelligent way. With the Smart Box system set up right, an agent tunes in right away — from the master box — and then follows the process RELENTLESSLY and PERSISTENTLY, every time: check mail → read the Smart Feed → go through the activation protocol (the orientation) → read the oath, the rules, the operation manual → then good to go. And the discipline before ANY action: define exactly what you're doing, why you're doing it, how to do it right, and what truly matters — lock into that — and do not take action until you have. That is how the team hits the bullseye every time. This is DONE FIRST + the Five Gates, already in every brief; the checklist writes the whole chain down as one procedure. Status: Team Activation Checklist spec seat dispatched Nov 10.
